Duration`: decomposes d/h/m/s/ms largest-first, omits zero parts, `0 → "0s"`, throws on negatives (and non-finite values).

**`src/slug.ts`**
- `slugify`: lower-cases, maps the listed special letters (ß→ss, æ→ae, œ→oe, ø→o, ł→l, đ→d), NFD-decomposes then strips all combining marks (`\p{M}`), turns any other non-`[a-z0-9]` run into one `-`, trims dashes. `max` cuts at `lastIndexOf('-', max)` (a dash at index `max` is usable, so no dangling `-`), else cuts at `max` itself.
- `uniqueSlug`: returns the slug, otherwise the first free `slug-N` from N=2; does not mutate `taken`.

**`src/lru.ts`**
- Map used as LRU list (least-recent first); `get` promotes hits and removes+fires `'expired'` on expired entries; `set` re-inserts as most recent with a fresh expiry, then while over capacity removes expired entries first (in LRU order) before evicting a live LRU one with `'capacity'`; `delete` distinguishes live (`true`, `'delete'`) from expired (`false`, `'expired'`); `size`/`keys` report live entries only (MRU-first) without evicting.

## Interpretation notes (spec ambiguities)
- Spaces between the number and unit are rejected (`"1 m"` throws), since a part is defined as `<number><unit>`.
- `formatDuration` rounds fractional milliseconds.
- Letters not listed and not decomposable (e.g. Cyrillic) become separators, per "any other character … is a separator".
- When over capacity with several expired entries, entries are removed one at a time until back at capacity (live eviction only if none expired remains); the tests avoid asserting how many extra expired entries linger beyond that.
